description: Adds the design in another size beside it: story, post, square (re-laid out by the style’s own layout, words and photo carried over), or youtube, banner, landscape, facebook, linkedin, pinterest, poster, a4, a5 (scaled, texts kept in the safe area). Use it for «make a story version», «for YouTube». Nothing is removed. Example: { design, to: «story» }.

artboard.description: the artboard to resize; none: the first

design.description: the design’s id or Paletoo link

relayout.description: layout (default): the style’s own layout when it has one; scale: always scale

name: resize_design
title: Resize to another format
